descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S25 Existing specs: the encounter notepad opens full screen and is tall enough to read a dictation back, both modes

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 The encounter notepad renders full-size, matching Vikram's app. (TFA-92592 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Tim's chromium specs

When Run the three specs by title

Then The Hospital and Nursing Home encounter notepads open full screen and close with the text kept, and the Hospital notepad has at least 12 rows and is at least 260 px tall

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright verdicts. 'Matching Vikram's app' is a side-by-side look with the prototype, recorded by a human with the S22 screenshots

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-14/S25

Existing specs: the encounter notepad opens full screen and is tall enough to read a dictation back, both modes

Tickets: TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for pr)

Existing specs:

  • chart.spec.ts [chromium] — the notepad is tall enough to read a dictation back — expected
  • encounter-notepad.spec.ts [chromium] — the hospital encounter notepad opens full-screen and closes — expected
  • encounter-notepad.spec.ts [chromium] — the nursing-home encounter notepad opens full-screen and closes — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's chromium specs): fresh @roundai.test accounts seeded through e2e/support with the local admin key; dev has no admin key, so they run on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
